slices.focus: Ariana realizes milder seafood dishes help her eczema during stress and humidity
slices.summary: At a family cookout, Ariana eats a mild shrimp stew meant for kids and notices her skin feels less inflamed afterward. She decides to choose gentler, less pepper-heavy meals when stress and eczema are both high.
open_loops: Asking her aunt for the mild shrimp stew recipe
Building a short rotation of mild, low-effort lunches
Testing whether spice reduction helps broadly or only with seafood
decisions: Ariana started favoring milder seafood stews and less pepper-heavy meals when stress made her eczema act up.
